snapshot.text: Tax-funded system run by 21 regions, with national government setting the frame. Waiting times are the main political issue, and the government is investigating national procurement of healthcare.

priorities.title: Shorter waiting times
priorities.text: The government sees a possible turning point in healthcare queues.

priorities.title: National procurement of healthcare
priorities.text: Health economist Clas Rehnberg is investigating national procurement of healthcare for the government.

priorities.title: Strategy for rare health conditions
priorities.text: Sweden adopted its first national strategy for rare health conditions.
